headline: The border gets a real calendar — PAPERS, PLEASE-MIN's week crosses a month-end
lede: In the original, comparing stamps against the desk calendar IS the job, and October rolls into November. Our week sat frozen at Oct 11-17; it now runs OCT 27 through NOV 02, with one exact clock behind every date the rules judge.

notes.text: PAPERS, PLEASE-MIN: day 5 is 1982.10.31, day 6 is 1982.11.01 — mid-campaign the wall turns to a new month, and day 6's EXPIRED test paper is judged across the boundary (wall 1982.11.01 vs passport EXPIRES 1982.10.31 at the same window). CURFEW's seven-day grace now counts real days: over a 30-day November, exactly 6 days left is void, exactly 7 walks.

Rolling the week found a real bug the frozen calendar hid: dadd had no backward carry and shipped NOV 00 as day 6's yesterday — the fairness prover stayed green (serial ordering was sane; only the printed date lied, and the display is the contract). Carry added; serials are now exact days-since-epoch, so the calendar and the number every rule compares cannot disagree. paperscheck gains a ~60-gate CALENDAR section and two new mutants (uniform-31 re-freeze, carry strip) — 6551/6551, all 10 mutants die; papersplay 19/19 real keys, seed 2 survives the rolled week, zero page errors.

look.text: Hold the line through OCT 31 — day 6 at the border says NOVEMBER
